messages:
ana: Heads-up: security scan found OIDC trust policies with aud set to '*' in a few ingest roles. This permits other tenants' tokens to assume our roles. Need emergency lockdown and quick fixes. 24h SLA. :warning:

sec-bot: iam-scan v1.5 detected 4 hits across prod & staging at 2026-03-23T02:10Z. roles=[ingest/connector, metrics/relay, shared/ingest-bridge, ext/relay]. severity=high.

kai: Confirmed. I'll push tight trust policies locking tokens.example.com:aud to our tenant URIs. Will open PRs. ETA 3h.

oncall-sre: Temporary mitigation: added a WAF rule to block AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity where aud == '*' from tokens.example.com. Monitoring for consumer errors.

ana: (typo: ana) quick remediation checklist: 1) replace '*' with explicit aud values; 2) rotate JWKs/clients at IdP; 3) request partner forced reauth if partner-managed; 4) run verification script and post results here.

infra-bot: auto-PR opener attempted fixes for 2 roles; 2 roles flagged for manual review due to complex conditions. Links: infra/iam#4901, infra/iam#4902.

kai: PRs created and tests added that assert no '*' auds. Running verify script now.

oncall-sre: saw ~1m spike in 403s from downstream pipelines right after WAF rule; has stabilized. No rollback required.

sec-bot: ticket SEC-2026-119 created, severity=high, target-remediation=2026-03-24T02:10Z. Notifying legal/compliance for assessment.

ana: Good progress. Once PRs merge and IdP rotates keys, we'll remove WAF rule after 24h of normal telemetry. Postmortem to follow. Thanks team. :lock:
